known_risk_areas.area: Generated package packets can drift from the membership ledger
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L12 packet membership currency check; L21 WP-I10-003 structural check; rebuild from authoritative work-packages.json
known_risk_areas.history: WP-I10-003 previously described two requirements while owning three; corrected and regression-tested

known_risk_areas.area: Validators could pass on keyword presence instead of structure
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L21 validates structured amendment fields; validator-audit stage 9 of the pre-GPT audit
known_risk_areas.history: L21 was substring-based; rewritten to structured validation

known_risk_areas.area: Adversarial fixtures could share one mutation across many purposes
known_risk_areas.mitigation: Every fixture copies a valid baseline, applies one mutation, and asserts one intended error
known_risk_areas.history: Amendment fixtures previously reused one empty artifact; replaced with independent fixtures

known_risk_areas.area: Component decision ownership can contradict the technical DAG
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L5 required technical edges; L19 consumer dependency and self-consumer checks
known_risk_areas.history: Installer/signing tools ownership moved from WP-I15-005 to WP-I15-001 to match the reviewed order

known_risk_areas.area: New memberships or dependencies can lack Pass B review rows
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L17 requires REVIEWED_CONFIRMED rows for every membership and dependency
known_risk_areas.history: CAN-LAM-AI-090 and 20 component-decision edges lacked review rows; added

known_risk_areas.area: Independent verification rows can lack item-specific rationale
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L18 requires >=40 character item-specific rationale per row
known_risk_areas.history: 465 contract/test/exit-gate rows lacked the rationale column; enriched

known_risk_areas.area: Certification pipelines can persist the superseded declaration or stale counts
known_risk_areas.mitigation: L15 and L20 enforce the exact new declaration; pass3_persist_certification.py computes counts from authoritative data
known_risk_areas.history: Pass 3 pipeline wrote the old declaration and hardcoded pre-amendment counts; corrected

known_risk_areas.mitigation: L21 checks the amendment object, component rules, packet sections, and membership
